newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stocks boosted by new listing.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stocks boosted by new listing.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Thursday 0.48 percent higher, boosted by the listing of leasing firm Maroc-Leasing, a broker said.
The all-share index closed at 537.71 from 535.15 points on Wednesday.
"Activity has been slackening these days and it seems that everybody was waiting for this listing," a broker at ABN Amro Finance said.
Maroc-Leasing floated last week, was 21.5 times oversubscribed to 4.5 million from 212,660 shares worth 48.9 million dirhams ($5.25 million).The offer price was 230 dirhams.
ONA group, the biggest private holding company, was up 15 dirhams to 690 dirhams.
Dairy firm, Centrale Laitiere soared to 2330 dirhams, up 50 dirhams.
In the banking sector, blue chip stock Wafabank closed at 685, up nine dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a blue chip stock, fell three dirhams to trade at 491 dirhams.
The second biggest conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement rose 19 dirhams to close at 667 dirhams.
Samir oil refinery, the country's main refinery, edged up one dirham to close at 251 dirhams.
Credit firm Credor which was floated late December jumped 21 dirhams to 640 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 53.3 million from 47.2 million dirhams on Wednesday.
($1= 9.3 dirhams)
